conviction_note: Adtran Networks SE is a controlled subsidiary under a domination and profit-transfer agreement (DPLTA) with ADTRAN Holdings, which holds 71.9%. Minority holders' value is fixed by the DPLTA's annual compensation payment and its EUR 17.21-plus-interest exit compensation, and it is re-priced only by the LG Meiningen appraisal case (Spruchverfahren), whose decision Holdings does not expect before late 2027 or 2028. The quarterly result therefore cannot move the minority economics. On the last eight result and ad-hoc days, including a Nov-2025 guidance cut, the close-to-close move was 0.0% on seven and at most one tick (about 0.45%) on the eighth. So abs_move is about one tick and p_up is 50, with no sign: the stage's 3%/7%/9% base rates describe ordinary equities and do not transfer to this name.

findings.finding: Under the DPLTA, effective 2023-01-16 per the Holdings 10-Q, the minority's economics are the fixed recurring compensation and the exit compensation of EUR 17.21 plus 6.27% guaranteed interest. The Q3 operating result therefore cannot re-price the stock. The company itself stated this for its last guidance cut, and the stock's eight prior result and ad-hoc days moved 0.0% (seven) or one tick.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Close-to-close on result days: 2025-02-27 -0.25%, 2025-05-08 0.0%, 2025-08-05 0.0%, 2025-11-04 0.0% (the same day as an FY25 guidance-cut ad-hoc), 2026-02-26 0.0%, 2026-05-05 0.0%, 2026-08-04 0.0%. The Holdings pre-release ad-hocs on 2025-07-16, 2026-01-22 and 2026-07-22 were also 0.0% (Yahoo ADV.DE daily closes).
findings.original_quote: The adjustment of the pro forma EBIT range does not affect the annual compensation payment to the outside shareholders.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced, and that is the point. This finding sizes the name's sensitivity to the print at about zero. If the market were treating ADV as an operating equity, prior result days would show 2-3% moves and the 20-day realised volatility would not be 12.5% annualised on EUR 0.10 ticks.
findings.independence: The Holdings 10-Q describes the DPLTA mechanics, the guaranteed interest and the extended tender window (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000926282/000119312526331632/adtn-20260630.htm); the price tape is a separate source.

outside_window.finding: Spruchverfahren LG Meiningen Az. HK O 3/23 (62 applicants): the hearing, postponed from 3 June and then 9 September to 29 September 2026, was cancelled outright on 28 August 2026 'aus dienstlichen Gründen' (for official/administrative reasons), and no new date has been published. The court-appointed expert (WP Wolfram Wagner) was due to file a supplementary opinion by 10 July 2026. Holdings expects a final decision in late 2027 or 2028. This is the only line that re-prices the minority stake, and nothing about it is due in the window. The stock fell from about EUR 23.0 to about EUR 21.5 over September-October after the cancellation, but the cause is not established, so this is not sized as a finding.

lessons_applied: 'In a live bid, results are noise ... the offer is the finding' applies by analogy to a DPLTA subsidiary: the Spruchverfahren is the finding, and it is outside the window. This confirmed the zero and changed no size.

'Too small about the move' (factor of three): abs_move raised from 0.5 to 0.6. It was not raised to the 3% base rate, because this name's own result-day moves are structurally about 0 and no line in the release can change minority value.
